description: This Java interface `Adaptable` defines a contract for objects that can be mapped to and from various Ditto signal types such as Command, CommandResponse, or Event. It provides methods for accessing a topic path, payload, headers, and header existence checking. It also includes a static method for creating a builder for `Adaptable` instances.

classes.name: Adaptable
classes.description: An interface representing objects that can be mapped to and from various Ditto signal types such as Command, CommandResponse, or Event.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing Adaptable instances, given a TopicPath.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Returns the TopicPath associated with this Adaptable.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the payload of this Adaptable.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing DittoHeaders if present; deprecated.

methods.name: containsHeaderForKey
methods.description: Checks if the Adaptable contains a header with a specified key.
